set.descriptionMd: Orange roses hand-tied with eucalyptus and a few sprigs of seasonal foliage, wrapped in kraft paper. Eighteen stems as standard. Warm rather than loud, so it reads as well for a birthday as for a thank you note on a kitchen table. Every order is made by hand and delivered in person by our florist in the recipient's city.
